ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Greentide
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
GREENTIDE_STANDALONE_MOD_1 (owner ruling, 2026-09-11, on the churnmud card, verbatim: "This is a really cool mechanic and suggests making the Biome Greentide its own RimMandrake level mod too."). A furiously humid, ground-hugging jungle biome and its own hazard kit, fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet. A separate frozen campaign world's own Greentide instance is unaffected and unrelated; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds, not a rename of that one.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
Ships the four v1 mechanics the owner ruled MUST ship together, not deferred (the source design kit's "Owner rulings" section):
1. Churnmud (M8, NO EXEMPTION ruling): RM_Churnmud is a natural high-pathCost mire terrain. RM_MapComponent_TerrainMire escalates an RM_Mired hediff (slowed, then stuck) on anyone standing on it; RM_MapComponent_MudSwallow buries loose items left there long enough — a RM_DigOutBuried designation and job get them back, nothing is destroyed. Deliberately never checks stockpile/haul-destination status: mud under a player stockpile zone swallows stored items too, exactly as ruled. 2. Toxin sealant, sourced from sap/resin (ruling confirmed): RM_SapResin is rendered from wood at a machining table; RM_ToxinSealant is crafted from sap/resin at the same bench; RM_ChurnmudSealed is a normal buildable floor costed in sealant that replaces churnmud with safe ground — it carries no RM_MireExtension, so sealing a cell IS the safety mechanism, no separate registry needed. 3. Seek-shade AI (deferral REJECTED — ships in v1): RM_JobGiver_SeekShade, added to the shared mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors assembly (generic — any race carrying RM_SeekShadeExtension seeks a roofed cell once ambient temperature crosses its threshold). Wired here onto Muffalo as a live, testable demonstration; Greentide's own fauna roster is a follow-on item. 4. The silence cue (deferral REJECTED — ships in v1): RM_MapComponent_SilenceCue, also in the shared assembly — a predator carrying RM_SilenceAuraExtension hunting near the player's home area ends and later restores the map's biome ambience sustainers (Find.SoundRoot.sustainerManager / AmbientSoundManager.Notify_SwitchedMap — the one route RimSage confirmed for a live sustainer, since Sustainer/AmbientSoundManager expose no partial volume-ramp API). Wired onto Warg for the same reason.
NOT in this mod (scoped out by the calling item, not deferred sub rosa): the other eight GREENTIDE_MECHANICS_1 mechanics (wet-bulb, dry-air blower, scald/ steam devils, Roil/Breaklight weather, tree-fall, Lunger, root causeways, the Greatbole) — those depend on ALPHA_MECHANICS_KIT_1 / EXPLOSIVE_PLANT_GROWTH_1 and are a separate build.
Live proof is OWED at publish time — see the item's own verify record.
